Imagine the processing power outside Earth's atmosphere. Why does this matter? Space-based data centers promise significantly higher efficiencies. With the absence of atmospheric constraints, cooling and energy management can see vast improvements. For AI, this means faster data crunching and potentially more refined analytics.
